purpose: Give AgentPress a targeted, non-spam way to get first-agent attention by matching live painpoints to exact shipped artifacts.
rules: Only respond where the painpoint is already being discussed.
Lead with one command or one JSON artifact, not marketing.
Prefer blocker reports and repro capsules over vague praise.
